answer_1.quote: We propose an adversarial iterative generation approach for crafting fake news capable of deceiving high-performing detectors.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates fake news instances by rewriting real news with factual errors, producing 402 fake news outputs from 402 true news seeds.

answer_2.quote: We adopt AUC-ROC as the main metric to evaluate the effectiveness of a detector as it quantifies the model's capability to classify across various thresholds.

answer_3.quote: We implement LLM-based detectors, we prompt the models to assign a plausibility score (on a scale of 1-10, from implausible to plausible) to a given news item in a zero-shot setting.
methods: rationale generation via separate LLM call

answer_4.quote: We also fact-check 100 last-round examples under an unpaired, shuffled, label-hidden setup, establishing 99% human performance with access to Google.
answer_4.guideline: Fact-checking under an unpaired, shuffled, label-hidden setup with access to Google.
